Armored Chassis.name: Армированная рама
Armored Chassis.description:
Armors the vehicle to SP13. Doesn't affect the glass.

Moto Rank Required: 5

Availability: All Vehicles

AV-4 Engine Upgrade.name: Двигатели AV-4
AV-4 Engine Upgrade.description:
Adds Aerodyne thrusters to the vehicle, allowing flight. While flying the vehicle has a narrative speed of 200MPH / 322KPH, and a combat speed of 40. The vehicle must be piloted using the Pilot Air Vehicle skill while mid-air.

Moto Rank Required: 7

Availability: All Land Vehicles

Backup Drive.name: Резервный диск
Backup Drive.description:
Saves non-Black ICE Programs when destroyed. These programs can be re-installed by a Netrunner as a meat action.

No automation provided — Does not prevent item deletion!

Bayonet.name: Штык-нож
Bayonet.description: An old idea that still works just as good; lets you use your gun as a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.hvxl5hrwWBPZmSwF]{Light Melee} weapon. While attached, the weapon can't be concealed under clothing.

Bulletproof Glass.name: Пуленепробиваемое стекло
Bulletproof Glass.description:
All glass on the vehicle is now considered cover with 15 HP. Can be taken a second time to upgrade to 30HP. All windows take damage individually. Refer to the cover rules in CP:R, pg. 182.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles

Combat Plow.name: Боевой кенгурятник
Combat Plow.description:
When you ram something with the front of your vehicle, your vehicle doesn't take damage and nobody inside suffers from the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-head.Item.e5wyX6r4Tem6bNwQ]{Whiplash} critical injury. You deal [[/r 2d6dmg #Bonus Ramming Damage]]{2d6} additional ramming damage if your vehicle was boosted by @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_upgrades.Item.LlcUvcVoCD6SeKOk]{NOS} on the turn you ram the object.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Land and Sea Vehicles, except Bikes and Jetskis.

Communications Center.name: Центр связи
Communications Center.description:
Touchscreen console that functions as an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}, along with a storage unit containing the following items:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Lo7rXsc5ToQf2KlN]{Audio Recorder}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.sMAZKb9ErPoQJ1vV]{Radio Scanner/Music Player}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.DO2Nzq3dw0R72dpm]{Radio Communicators} x6

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.CLaUNQ7cqa05XfFg]{Scrambler/Descramblers} x6

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.QIHx5oQOirtTlAaD]{Homing tracer} & @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.IqXTqNGBmSuigIWv]{Tracer Button} x6

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles

Deployable Spike Strip.name: Развёртываемая полоса с шипами
Deployable Spike Strip.description:
As an Action, the driver can deploy a spike strip. While deployed, any closely trailing vehicles with tires must make a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.ref+@skills.driveLandVehicle #DV17 Drive Land Vehicle]]{DV17 Drive Land Vehicle} check. On a failure, their vehicle takes [[/r 4d6dmg #Weak Point Damage]]{4d6} damage as if hitting a weak point. Replacement spike strips cost 10eb.

You may install this upgrade multiple times, each upgrade increases the amount of spike strips that can be deployed before the system requires reloading, and it cannot be reloaded while the vehicle is moving.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Groundcars

DNA Lock.name: Блокировка на ДНК
DNA Lock.description: Uses biometrics to lock the cyberdeck. Requires a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech+@skills.electronicsAndSecurityTech #DV17 Electronics/Security Tech]]{DV17 Electronics/Security Tech} check to crack.

Drum Magazine (Rocket Launcher).name: Барабанный магазин (ракетница)
Drum Magazine (Rocket Launcher).description: Некисло увеличивает размер магазина до 3 ракет. Бахнет — мама не горюй.

Enhanced Interface Plug Integration.name: Улучшенная интеграция разъёмов интерфейса
Enhanced Interface Plug Integration.description:
While using @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plugs} to drive this vehicle, if you have a REF 8 or higher and you, a passenger, or your bike are the target of an attack, you can attempt to dodge as you would on foot.

Moto Rank Required: 5

Availability: All Bikes

Grenade Launcher Underbarrel.name: Подствольный гранатомёт
Grenade Launcher Underbarrel.description:
Functions like a single shot @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.KgqUdz9Fs55747gv]{Grenade Launcher}.

While attached, the weapon can't be concealed under clothing.

Hardened Circuitry.name: Экранирование схем
Hardened Circuitry.description: ЭМИ не может отключить или уничтожить кибердеку.

Heavy Chassis.name: Утяжелённая рама
Heavy Chassis.description:
Adds 20 SDP to the vehicle. This doesn't affect the glass, and vehicle can now tow up to 10 tons.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles except Bikes Jetskis and Gyrocopters

Housing Capacity.name: Жилой отсек
Housing Capacity.description:
When installed onto a Groundcar or AV-4, it adds a sleeping area with 1 bed, a toilet, a shower, and a small kitchen to the vehicle. When installed into a Cabin Cruiser, Yacht, or Aerozep, it adds one room to the vehicle.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: Aerozep, AV-4, Cabin Cruiser, Groundcars, Yachts

Requires a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_upgrades.Item.YRDJbfFA4knBhApR]{Heavy Chassis} on a Compact Groundcar and High Performance Groundcar.

Hover Upgrade.name: Воздушная подушка
Hover Upgrade.description:
Adds fans onto the vehicle that allow it to traverse water at a narrative speed of 15 MPH/ 24KPH while hovering, and a combat speed of 10.

Moto Rank Required: 5

Availability: All Land Vehicles

Infrared Nightvision Scope.name: ИК прицел ночного видения
Infrared Nightvision Scope.description: Снижает штрафы от стрельбы по целям в темноте, дыму/тумане до нуля.

Insulated Wiring.name: Изолированная проводка
Insulated Wiring.description: Cyberdeck and user clothing cannot catch fire from Program effects.

KRASH Barrier.name: Барьер KRASH
KRASH Barrier.description: Cyberdeck is immune to effects that force the Netrunner to Jack Out (safely or unsafely).

NOS.name: Система закиси азота
NOS.description:
Adds a tank of nitrous oxide to the vehicle. Allows you to use your Action to use an additional Move Action while driving. You may install this upgrade multiple times, each upgrade adds an additional tank and each tank may be used once per day.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles

Onboard Flamethrower.name: Бортовой огнемёт
Onboard Flamethrower.description:
A @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.qAqYtbD1yFgQNelR]{Flamethrower} that can be mounted facing the front, side or back of the vehicle. The driver may fire it using an Action. It cannot be reloaded while driving, and cannot accept weapon attachments.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles

You may install this upgrade multiple times.

Onboard Machine Gun.name: Бортовой пулемёт
Onboard Machine Gun.description:
An @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.QrQNdHTuEDxrfIxS]{Assault Rifle} with a 30 round capacity and only capable of Autofire, that can be mounted facing the front of the vehicle. The driver may fire it using an Action, cannot be reloaded while driving and cannot accept weapon attachments.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles

You may install this upgrade multiple times.

Onboard Melee Weapon.name: Бортовое оружие ближнего боя
Onboard Melee Weapon.description:
A @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.PxOjhUUs7cRULv75]{Very Heavy Melee Weapon} that can be mounted facing the front, side or back of the vehicle. The driver may attack with it using an Action. The weapon cannot be removed.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles

You may install this upgrade multiple times.

Onboard Rocket Pod.name: Бортовой ракетный блок
Onboard Rocket Pod.description:
A @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.Fl6F6x2PstAthge7]{Rocket Launcher} with a drum of three rockets, that can be mounted facing the front of the vehicle. The driver may fire it using an Action. It cannot be reloaded while driving, and cannot accept weapon attachments.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles except Bikes, Jetskis and Gyrocopters

You may install this upgrade multiple times — Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_upgrades.Item.YRDJbfFA4knBhApR]{Heavy Chassis}.

Range Upgrade.name: Улучшение дальности
Range Upgrade.description: Кибердека может подключаться к точкам доступа на расстоянии до 8 м/ярд (вместо 6 м/ярд).

Seating Upgrade.name: Дополнительные сиденья
Seating Upgrade.description:
Can be installed as an external sidecar, they may also be installed as ejector seats with removable parachutes.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles

Can be taken multiple times with the exception of Bikes, Jetskis and Gyrocopters.

Security Upgrade.name: Дополнительная безопасность
Security Upgrade.description:
Adds DNA Locks to the vehicle requiring the correct biometrics or a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech+@skills.electronicsAndSecurityTech #DV17 Electronics/Security Tech]]{DV17 Electronics/Security Tech} check to unlock. An individual who fails to unlock the vehicle takes damage as if hit with a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.O1brHdazB6mqbVp1]{Stun Baton}.

After remaining stationary for 1 minute, the vehicle is cloaked and requires a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.int+@skills.perception #DV17 Perception]]{DV17 Perception} check to spot.

Moto Rank Required: 5

Availability: All Vehicles

Shotgun Underbarrel.name: Подствольный дробовик
Shotgun Underbarrel.description:
Requires 2 hands to use, and takes up 2 attachment slots.

While attached, the weapon can't be concealed under clothing.

Smartgun Link.name: Смартлинк
Smartgun Link.description: Turns weapon into a "Smartgun" that provides +1 bonus to attack if you have @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.2vSTximwCOxNPGJX]{Subdermal Grip} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plugs} installed.

Smuggling Upgrade.name: Отсек для контрабанды
Smuggling Upgrade.description:
Adds two @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.WDAHvqIooCSGWnCz]{Hidden Holsters} to the vehicle, and a large hidden compartment for smuggling purposes. These can be discovered with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.int+@skills.concealOrRevealObject #DV17 Conceal/Reveal Object]]{DV17 Conceal/Reveal Object} check.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles

Can be taken multiple times with the exception of Bikes, Jetskis and Gyrocopters.

Sniping Scope.name: Снайперский прицел
Sniping Scope.description: Позволяет чётко видеть на расстоянии до 800 м/ярд. +1 к одиночным и прицельным выстрелам на расстоянии от 50 м/ярд.

Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount.name: Крепление для тяжёлого оружия
Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount.description:
One of the vehicles seats becomes a swivel mount for any two-handed ranged weapon. If the vehicle has the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_upgrades.Item.Pj3nZU2coYUGIjR3]{Bulletproof Glass} upgrade, the gunner is protected by the same glass. A passenger may fire the weapon using an Action. The passenger can reload the weapon. The weapon can be removed or reinstalled using an Action. The first time this upgrade is taken, choose one of the following:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.Rju0qV9mEaZ8oJhG]{Tsunami Arms Helix}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.DXVvTnvnQKLp9Uky]{Rhinemetall EMG-86 Railgun}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.IctYbE3ZOOR2yw5H]{Militech "Cowboy" U-56 Grenade Launcher}

Moto Rank Required: 7

Availability: All Vehicles except Bikes, Jetskis and Gyrocopters

You may install this upgrade multiple times if the vehicle has the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_upgrades.Item.qFItKouR0zGYlnta]{Housing Capacity} upgrade. Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_upgrades.Item.YRDJbfFA4knBhApR]{Heavy Chassis}.
